description: This file defines the Goteo\Library\Cacher class, which serves as a wrapper around the FileSystemCache component. It provides methods for cache management including setting/getting cache groups and times, generating cache keys, storing, retrieving, modifying, invalidating cache entries, and handling cache files.

classes.name: Cacher
classes.description: A cache management class that acts as a wrapper around the FileSystemCache, providing methods to handle caching operations such as storing, retrieving, modifying, and invalidating cache entries, along with cache configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Cacher instance with optional cache group and time-to-live (TTL).

methods.name: setCacheGroup
methods.description: Sets the cache group name for grouping cache entries.

methods.name: getCacheGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache group name.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key object based on provided key data and optional subgroup.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores data in the cache under a specified key with optional TTL.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Retrieves and modifies a cache entry atomically using a callback function.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates (removes) a cache entry identified by its key.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves cached data by key, optionally only if the cache is newer than a specific timestamp.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the full path to the cache file for a given filename, creating necessary directories.

methods.name: flushFile
methods.description: Streams the contents of a cache file directly to the browser.

methods.name: getFileCached
methods.description: Returns the full path of the cache file for a given cache key, creating directories if needed.

methods.name: getCacheDir
methods.description: Returns the base directory path used for cache storage.

methods.name: setCacheDir
methods.description: Sets the directory path for cache storage if writable and exists.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Invalidates all cache entries associated with the current group.
